name: Tabs
layerWhy: It switches between faces of one thing; it moves, and does no job of its own.
promise: Each tab is another face of the same thing, and choosing one shows it at once.
expectation: A row of names with the chosen one underlined, and its face under it.
evidence: The chosen tab is underlined in the primary and announced as selected; faces keep their state while hidden.
behaviour: One tab stop; ← → move and show (following the reading direction); Home and End go to the ends.
context: Summary, Data, History of one report. Never unrelated places, never filters.
relationships: Each tab labels its panel; a tab worth sharing keeps its face in the address.
accessibility: tablist, tab and tabpanel roles, linked by ids.
failures: Never loses what was typed in a hidden face.
do: Put the most used face first.
dont: Tabs that navigate between unrelated pages.
